title: Background launcher end: wrapped detached launch reports TerminalNotConfirmed instead of the wrapper refusal; D2 rival-contest path untested
outcome: At a Claude Bash background task's end, a launch through a shell wrapper is refused with the wrapper refusal (ArtifactRequestMismatch, ObservationMatches=false) whether or not it is detached, and a sole registration whose start cannot be read is shown by a test to be contested by any rival launch row.
acceptance: attach_claude_background_launcher_artifact checks for a direct launcher line before the detached check, so `bash -c "node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --input commit --detach"` records ArtifactRequestMismatch with ObservationMatches=false while a direct detached line keeps TerminalNotConfirmed; and a behaviour test shows a sole uncarried registration with an unreadable start plus one uncarried rival launch row with a readable window records ArtifactLocatorAmbiguous and attaches nothing.
